content_sections.heading: JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident (BDS) posts at Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident (BDS) position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior Resident (BDS) post, candidates must possess a BDS degree from a recognized University and be registered with the Delhi Dental Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Resident (BDS) role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Resident (BDS) position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (BDS) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Resident (BDS) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 56100 to Rs. 177500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (BDS) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Resident (BDS) position at Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of their ID proof, educational certificates, registration certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident (BDS) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Resident (BDS) posts involves a Written Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital located?
faq.answer: Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital is located in Delhi, with a pincode of 110053.
